paper_title: Context Consistency between Training and Testing in Simultaneous Machine   Translation
caption: BLEU comparison between context consistency and context inconsistency under the prefix-constrained decoding Setting. The x-aixs denotes the number of tokens for the gold prefix.
model_annotation: This line plot illustrates the relationship between the length of a gold prefix and the BLEU score for two conditions: context consistency and context inconsistency. The x-axis is labeled "the length of gold prefix" with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 20, with tick labels at every 5 units. The y-axis is labeled "BLEU" with a linear scale ranging from 23 to 29. A blue, dashed line with circular markers represents the context consistency condition, starting at a BLEU score of approximately 23.8 at x=0 and increasing to approximately 28.2 at x=20, with a local minimum of approximately 25.2 at x=6 and a local maximum of approximately 26.4 at x=11. A red, dashed line with square markers represents the context inconsistency condition, beginning at a BLEU score of approximately 25.2 at x=0 and fluctuating between approximately 25.1 and 25.6 across the x-axis range, ending at approximately 25.4 at x=20.
